title: Dream2Discern: Learning from Hard Latent Variants for Runtime Failure Prediction in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.16071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM-based multi-agent systems calls for runtime auditors that predict terminal outcomes from observed execution prefixes. These auditors typically learn from a limited corpus of trajectories with verified outcomes. Expanding this corpus requires costly execution and verification, yet broader failure coverage alone provides no explicit criterion for identifying prefixes that the current auditor finds difficult to classify. To this end, we propose Dream2Discern, a runtime auditor trained through implicit augmentation guided by its own prediction loss. During Dream, we select perturbations of the auditor's representation operators to increase prediction loss on recorded prefixes, yielding hard latent variants. During Discern, the auditor learns to predict execution outcomes from these variants using the original labels. The variants are regenerated as the auditor learns, turning a limited corpus into a renewable sou

translated_title: Dream2Discern：从困难潜在变体中学习以实现多智能体系统的运行时故障预测
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统的可靠部署需要运行时审计器，能够根据观察到的执行前缀预测最终结果。这些审计器通常从带有已验证结果的有限轨迹语料库中学习。扩充该语料库需要高昂的执行与验证成本，而仅仅扩大失败覆盖范围并不能提供明确的标准来识别当前审计器难以分类的前缀。为此，我们提出了 Dream2Discern，一个通过由自身预测损失引导的隐式增强来训练的运行时审计器。在 Dream 阶段，我们选择对审计器表示算子的扰动，以增加其在已记录前缀上的预测损失，从而产生困难潜在变体。在 Discern 阶段，审计器学习使用原始标签从这些变体中预测执行结果。随着审计器的学习，这些变体会被不断重新生成，从而将有限的语料库转变为可再生的数据来源。
tldr: Dream2Discern 通过利用自身预测损失引导生成困难潜在变体进行隐式数据增强，将有限的轨迹语料库转化为可再生的训练资源，使运行时审计器能够更准确地预测多智能体系统的最终执行结果。
en_tdlr: Dream2Discern trains a runtime auditor through implicit augmentation guided by its own prediction loss, generating hard latent variants that turn a limited trajectory corpus into a renewable data source for accurate failure prediction in multi-agent systems.
